title: Use the actual residual fault character rather than counting fault occurrences
statement: For the minimal retained Pauli factor, chi_t(Q)_i is its commutation character and Im chi_t=Im B_t. Under an exogenous state-independent joint classical Pauli path, with arbitrary temporal correlations, chi(f)=xor_t chi_t(Q_t), including any acquired syndrome-dependent prescribed correction. Against the SAME noisy receiver on common input, exact complete-instrument half-diamond error is1-Pr[chi(f)=0], within epsilon_c after finite compilation.
